types.name: Commodity
docs: PDA `["cmdty", symbol[12]]`.

fields.name: decimals
docs: Always COIN_DECIMALS (6).

fields.name: feed_id
docs: Pyth feed id (or Switchboard feed pubkey bytes).

fields.name: feed_account
docs: PythPull: PriceUpdateV2 account posted by keeper; Switchboard: quote account.

fields.name: quote_scale
docs: 0 = USD, 1 = US cents (÷100), 2 = EUR (× fx).

fields.name: supply_cap
docs: Coin base units.

fields.name: per_tx_cap
docs: Coin base units.

fields.name: last_publish_time
docs: Last accepted oracle publish time (monotonic guard).

fields.name: pyth_min_signatures
docs: Carved from CONTRACTS.md `_reserved[64]` (byte-compatible): minimum Wormhole signatures
accepted on a partially-verified Pyth update. 0 = require `VerificationLevel::Full`.

fields.name: daily_mint_cap
docs: Max COIN minted per rolling `DAILY_WINDOW_SECS` window (base units). 0 = no cap.

fields.name: daily_redeem_cap
docs: Max USDC paid out by `sell` per window (base units). 0 = no cap.

fields.name: window_start
docs: Start of the current window (unix). Rolled forward lazily by trades.

fields.name: max_deviation_bps
docs: Max |oracle − last_price| / last_price in bps accepted by a trade while the previous
trade's oracle read is younger than `deviation_window_secs`. 0 = disabled.
Applies to every oracle kind (KeeperPrice.max_move_bps only bounds keeper posts).

fields.name: deviation_window_secs
docs: How long `last_price` stays the deviation anchor after `last_publish_time` (secs).

fields.name: symbol
docs: ASCII A-Z0-9, right-padded with 0u8 to 12 bytes.

fields.name: feed_account
docs: PythPull: PriceUpdateV2 account; Switchboard (stand-in): KeeperPrice PDA; else default.

fields.name: pyth_min_signatures
docs: 0 = require fully verified Pyth updates.

fields.name: name
docs: Metaplex name (≤ 32 bytes) and uri (≤ 200 bytes).

types.name: GlobalConfig
docs: PDA `["config"]`.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Owner of the USDC token account that receives swept spread fees.

fields.name: reserve_mint
docs: USDC mint.

fields.name: max_conf_bps
docs: Reject oracle if conf / price > this (default 200).

fields.name: reserve_warn_bps
docs: Default 10_200: below this spreads double and sweeps are refused.

fields.name: reserve_halt_bps
docs: Default 9_800: buys revert if the post-trade ratio is below this.

fields.name: redeem_cap_exempt
docs: Carved from `_reserved` (byte-compatible; default = Pubkey::default() = nobody): a `sell`
signer exempt from `Commodity.daily_redeem_cap` — the buyback program's `bb_auth` PDA, whose
volume is already bounded by `BuybackState.max_per_cycle_usdc`.

types.name: IndexLeg
docs: One leg of a Composite (index) coin.
CONTRACTS.md declares this `#[zero_copy]`; it is Borsh here because it lives inside a Borsh
`#[account]`. The byte layout is identical (32 + 2 + 6 = 40 bytes, no padding).

types.name: KeeperPrice
docs: PDA `["kp", commodity]`. Prices here are already USD at 1e8 (quote_scale is not applied).

types.name: ReserveAlert
docs: ratio_bps is u64 because an over-collateralised reserve can exceed u16::MAX bps.

types.name: Trade
docs: side: 0 = buy, 1 = sell. `price` is the oracle mid (1e8), `spread_bps` the effective spread.
